name: Bookiso – Multipurpose Service Appointment Booking & Form Builder
author: Akram ul haq

sections.description:
Bookiso helps service businesses accept appointments online. Configure listings for doctors, spas, coaches, consultants, and more with flexible service types, custom fields, availability rules, and a customer-friendly booking wizard.

Bookiso Core — Included Free

  • Dynamic bookable listings with custom post type labels and slugs
  • Service types with custom fields and optional pricing
  • Global form builder plus per-listing field visibility
  • Weekly availability, time slots, capacity, and blackout dates
  • Multi-step booking wizard with smart step visibility
  • Slot holds while customers complete the form
  • Admin bookings list, calendar, and reviews moderation
  • Customer My Bookings area with guest lookup
  • Customer cancel and reschedule with configurable policy
  • Saved listings and post-booking reviews
  • REST API for booking, availability, reviews, and saved listings
  • Shortcodes: [bookiso] and [bookiso_my_bookings]

Bookiso Pro

Bookiso Pro requires Bookiso Core and adds payments, advanced booking features, wizard design, notifications, and automation.

  • Payments — Stripe, PayPal, offline payments, required payment, refunds, and receipt PDF
  • Booking — Coupon codes, recurring appointments, and add-to-calendar with Google, Apple, and ICS
  • Wizard design — Tab order, display options, and brand colors
  • Notifications — Email, WhatsApp, and SMS through Twilio with customizable templates
  • Calendar — Google Calendar OAuth synchronization
  • Admin — Coupons, payment capture, and invoice settings

Get Bookiso Pro:
Bookiso – Multipurpose Service Appointment Booking Pro

Bookiso Staff Add-on

Requires Bookiso Core. Best with Bookiso Pro for payments and notifications.

  • Staff selection step in the booking wizard
  • Per-staff availability, schedules, and time off
  • Staff profiles and listing assignment
  • Dedicated staff portal with schedule, calendar, and booking actions
  • Per-staff Google Calendar synchronization
  • Vendor team support when used with Bookiso Multivendor

Bookiso Partial Payments Add-on

Requires Bookiso Core + Bookiso Pro.

  • Deposits at booking with percentage or fixed amounts
  • Customer choice to pay in full or pay a deposit
  • Online balance payments via Stripe or PayPal
  • Optional payment of remaining balance at the venue
  • Payment ledger on each booking
  • Balance due reminders
  • Overdue balance flagging for administrators

Bookiso Multivendor Add-on

Requires Bookiso Core + Bookiso Pro.

  • Vendor registration and approval workflow
  • Listing approval before going live
  • Platform dashboard, vendor management, and revenue reports
  • Vendor portal for listings, bookings, calendar, and earnings
  • Commission rules with percentage or fixed amounts
  • PayPal payouts, manual and scheduled
  • Team users per vendor with Bookiso Staff

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bookiso-service-appointment-booking directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Bookiso → Settings to configure your listing type and general options.
  4. Create listings, assign service types, set availability, and embed the booking form with [bookiso id="123"].
sections.faq:
Does this plugin handle payments?

Online payments are available in Bookiso Pro. The free plugin includes the booking engine and admin workflow.

Bookiso Pro adds Stripe, PayPal, and offline payments in the booking wizard.

Can I see live demos before buying?

Yes. Bookiso includes industry demo landing pages for doctors, dentists, spas, salons, gyms, consultants, and other service businesses.

Open any demo link in the description above or visit:

https://service-appointment-booking-wp-plugin.com/

Can I rename the listing post type?

Yes. Use Bookiso → Settings to set singular and plural names and URL slugs for your business type.

Can I hide wizard steps when they are empty?

Yes. The booking wizard automatically hides empty service and extra-information steps per listing.

What other Bookiso plugins are available?

Bookiso Pro adds payments, wizard design, and notifications.

Additional add-ons include:

  • Bookiso Staff for team scheduling
  • Bookiso Partial Payments for deposits and balance payments
  • Bookiso Multivendor for marketplace functionality

See Bookiso website for the full feature reference.
